subject: Finalize activation window & signer schedule for Nimbus MAP
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP recap & request to lock final signer window

Hi Jordan —

Great meeting this morning. Per our MAP, we pulled the artifacts together (attached MAP_Nimbus_v4.pdf and the SOW draft). To keep us on track for the April POC start, we need to lock down two things this week:

1) Final signer window (we need a 48-hour window where all Nimbus execs are available to sign). Proposed: Tue 2027-03-08 09:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2027-03-09 14:00–16:00 PT.
2) Activation start date — Redwood recommends Apr 1 for POC kickoff so we have full week for provisioning and smoke tests.

Can you confirm which window works for procurement/finance/legal? We’ve included a signature_matrix.xlsx to make approvals explicit (who signs what and sequencing).

Attachments: MAP_Nimbus_v4.pdf, SOW_Nimbus_v2.docx, signature_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll stand by to adjust once you confirm.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Miller <jordan@nimbushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, Marcia Lopez <mlopez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP recap & request to lock final signer window

Evelyn — thanks, that helps. Quick updates from our side:

- Procurement confirmed the proposed Tue 03/08 morning slot is preferable; finance prefers morning as well.
- Legal (Marcia) has two very small redlines on the SOW (data retention clause and clause on audit logs). We attached comments in the SOW; nothing blocking but need legal signoff.
- Can you confirm the final billing milestone wording (we'd like the first invoice at POC start instead of after acceptance).

If Redwood can incorporate the two legal tweaks and confirm billing milestone = invoice at POC start, we can commit to the Tue 03/08 09:00–10:30 PT signer window and lock Apr 1 start.

Jordan
CTO, Nimbus Health

From: Marcia Lopez <mlopez@nimbushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Miller <jordan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-03-01T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP recap & request to lock final signer window

Evelyn / team — forwarding inline comments from Legal. See redlines in SOW_Nimbus_v2.docx (tracked changes).

We are fine with the POC timeline; the only outstanding is the retention window in section 7.2 and adding a short description of audit log retention in Annex B. If Redwood can accept retention = 90 days for POC and provide SOC-2 evidence from your control plane, we can sign.

Marcia
Senior Counsel, Nimbus Health

-----Forwarded attachment: SOW_Nimbus_v2.docx (comments)-----

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: legal tweaks + signer availability — need go/no-go from execs

Team — quick internal note before I reply to Nimbus:

- Legal asks: Retention = 90 days for POC (OK) and SOC-2 evidence (we can provide the report redacted). Aditya, can you drop the SOC-2 exec summary into Annex B and update 7.2 to 90 days?
- Billing milestone: they want invoice at POC start. Lauren, confirm commercial is comfortable with that; we can shift invoicing but want payment terms to remain Net30.
- Signer window: They want Tue 03/08 09:00–10:30 PT. I propose we lock it and schedule a 15-minute dry-run on Mon 03/07 10:00 PT for the signers so we avoid last-minute timing issues.

Goal: I need a final "GO" or "HOLD" from you both by EOD 03/02 so I can send a consolidated response and push DocuSign.

Thanks — Evelyn

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan@nimbushealth.com>, Marcia Lopez <mlopez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-03-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: FINAL: GO for Tue 03/08 09:00–10:30 PT signer window — DocuSign sent

Jordan/Marcia — thanks for the confirmation and for surfacing the redlines. Per our internal alignment: 

- We accepted retention = 90 days for the POC only and added a 1‑paragraph SOC-2 exec summary to Annex B (see attached MAP & SOW final).
- Billing milestone updated so first invoice is issued at POC start; payment terms remain Net30.
- We have locked the signer window: Tue 2027-03-08 09:00–10:30 PT. Please ensure the listed signers in signature_matrix.xlsx are available; DocuSign envelope has been sent to the primary signers and to your procurement mailbox.
- We scheduled a 15-minute dry-run on Mon 2027-03-07 10:00 PT to confirm signing order and connection checks.

Next steps (explicit):
- Nimbus: confirm that the procurement mailbox will click through DocuSign when primary signers are available.
- Redwood (Aditya): share redacted SOC-2 exec summary in Annex B and upload to the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-94721).
- Redwood (Lauren): confirm final invoice schedule and send final SOW for signature.

Assuming signatures complete within the 03/08 window, we will provision dedicated capacity and target Apr 1 2027 as POC start date (smoke tests 03/29–03/31). If signatures slip beyond 03/10, we will need to push the POC start by one week.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0xA12B3C
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/94721

Attachments: MAP_Nimbus_v4.pdf, SOW_Nimbus_v2_final.docx, signature_matrix.xlsx

See you all on the dry-run Monday.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: 415-555-0134
